verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs list current-generation B200, H100 and GH200 instances on On-Demand Cloud and 1-Click Clusters, and the pricing page also lists A100 as a previous-generation option. Previous-generation choice rests on that single A100 mention, with nothing showing it is cheaper and no H200 in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented H200 availability, an explicit range of previous-generation instance types with lower pricing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the GPU lineup.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options
